name: result_read
title: Read up to 12000 UTF-8 bytes by opaque result_id. Follow next_offset and next_byte_offset as byte_offset within that line. Join byte continuations directly, ordinary line pages with LF. Results expire or may be evicted.
description: Read up to 12000 UTF-8 bytes by opaque result_id. Follow next_offset and next_byte_offset as byte_offset within that line. Join byte continuations directly, ordinary line pages with LF. Results expire or may be evicted.

result_id.description: Opaque result ID returned by an Retriever tool

byte_offset.description: UTF-8 byte offset within the selected line; pass next_byte_offset unchanged (default: 0)

name: web_search
title: Search: find web pages, articles, or data. Use Brave for operators, Exa for semantic or deep search, Tavily for factual results, and You.com as a fast fallback.
description: Search: find web pages, articles, or data. Use Brave for operators, Exa for semantic or deep search, Tavily for factual results, and You.com as a fast fallback.

limit.description: Maximum results. Tavily max 20; Brave/You cap at 20; Exa max 100. Defaults are provider-specific.

include_domains.description: Only return results from these domains

search_type.description: Exa search type. Only used when provider is exa.

category.description: Exa category filter. Only used when provider is exa.

user_location.description: Two-letter Exa user location country code, such as US.

contents.description: Exa contents options. Only used when provider is exa.

output_schema.description: Exa JSON output schema for synthesized output.

system_prompt.description: Exa system prompt for synthesized output.

additional_queries.description: Additional top-level Exa search queries for multi-query retrieval.

name: ai_search
title: Answer/Research: get synthesized answers; citation availability depends on the provider. Use Exa for fast or deep research, Brave Answers for plain-text grounded answers, Tavily for research; use action=status with request_id to resume without creating another paid job, Linkup for sourced answers.
description: Answer/Research: get synthesized answers; citation availability depends on the provider. Use Exa for fast or deep research, Brave Answers for plain-text grounded answers, Tavily for research; use action=status with request_id to resume without creating another paid job, Linkup for sourced answers.

query.description: Question or search query; required except for Tavily action=status

action.description: Default research. status is only for tavily_research and performs a read-only GET.

request_id.description: Existing Tavily task ID, required only for action=status

output_schema.description: JSON schema for structured output. Only used when provider is exa_deep_research.

exa_deep_search_type.description: Exa deep search mode. Only used when provider is exa_deep_research.

system_prompt.description: Exa system prompt. Only used when provider is exa_deep_research.

name: web_extract
title: Extract/Process: read or process known URLs. Firecrawl handles scrape/summarize/crawl/map/extract/actions/search; Exa handles contents/similar; Tavily extracts.
description: Extract/Process: read or process known URLs. Firecrawl handles scrape/summarize/crawl/map/extract/actions/search; Exa handles contents/similar; Tavily extracts.

url.description: URL, Exa result ID, or array of up to 20 values. Required for all modes except Firecrawl search.

query.description: Search query (required when mode=search with Firecrawl). Also used by Tavily extract for chunk reranking.

provider.description: Provider to use: Firecrawl for scrape/summarize/crawl/map/extract/actions/search, Exa for contents/similar, Tavily for extraction.

mode.description: Provider mode. firecrawl supports scrape/summarize/crawl/map/extract/actions/search; exa supports contents/similar; tavily supports extract. Defaults to provider default.

formats.description: Firecrawl scrape response formats. Defaults to markdown.

question.description: Ask a focused extraction question during scrape.

highlights_query.description: Return relevant page highlights for this query.

lockdown.description: Use Firecrawl lockdown/cache-only behavior when supported.

storeInCache.description: Allow Firecrawl to store the scrape result in cache.

zeroDataRetention.description: Request zero data retention where supported.

onlyMainContent.description: Prefer main article or page content.

onlyCleanContent.description: Return cleaned page content when supported.

removeBase64Images.description: Remove base64 images to avoid huge payloads.

firecrawl_options.description: Firecrawl scrape-only options: question, highlights_query, lockdown, cache, zero-data-retention, PII redaction, and content-cleaning flags.

sources.description: Firecrawl search verticals. Defaults to web.

categories.description: Firecrawl search categories for narrowed retrieval.

ignoreInvalidURLs.description: Skip invalid URLs in search results.

formats.description: Formats to scrape for each Firecrawl search hit.

onlyMainContent.description: Scrape only main content for each hit.

redactPII.description: Redact PII in scraped search-hit content.

scrapeOptions.description: Optional scrape settings applied to Firecrawl search results. Basic depth returns snippets without scraping; advanced depth or explicit formats scrape each hit (one scrape credit per result).

firecrawl_search_options.description: Firecrawl search-only options: sources, categories, domain filters, geo/time filters, and per-result scrape settings.

name: brave_llm_context
title: Research Context/RAG: retrieve LLM-ready grounding chunks from Brave. Use for dense context, not ordinary link search.
description: Research Context/RAG: retrieve LLM-ready grounding chunks from Brave. Use for dense context, not ordinary link search.

query.description: Search query to get LLM-optimized context for.

maximum_number_of_urls.description: Max different URLs to include in context.

goggles.description: Brave Goggles URL or inline definition for reranking.

name: brave_media_search
title: Media Search: find Brave image or video results with SafeSearch and country/language filters. Use only when visual media results are needed.
description: Media Search: find Brave image or video results with SafeSearch and country/language filters. Use only when visual media results are needed.

name: brave_news_search
title: News Search: find recent news articles with freshness, pagination, country/language, SafeSearch, and snippets.
description: News Search: find recent news articles with freshness, pagination, country/language, SafeSearch, and snippets.

name: firecrawl_agent
title: Autonomous Web Agent: Credit-sensitive; start a web task (default cap 100 credits), then use action=status or cancel with job_id. Repeating start creates a new paid job. Prefer search/extract for simple tasks.
description: Autonomous Web Agent: Credit-sensitive; start a web task (default cap 100 credits), then use action=status or cancel with job_id. Repeating start creates a new paid job. Prefer search/extract for simple tasks.

job_id.description: Existing job ID for status/cancel; never starts a new job.

prompt.description: Natural-language prompt for a new paid job. Start returns immediately; use status with job_id to retrieve results.

wait_for_completion.description: Opt into a bounded wait on start. Default false; status never creates a new job.

max_credits.description: Maximum credits to spend; positive integer. Defaults to 100, not the provider default.

name: context_web_extract
title: Context.dev Web: scrape markdown/HTML/images/screenshots, crawl pages, get sitemaps, or web-search with optional markdown scraping.
description: Context.dev Web: scrape markdown/HTML/images/screenshots, crawl pages, get sitemaps, or web-search with optional markdown scraping.

name: context_brand_intel
title: Context.dev Brand: retrieve brand/company intelligence such as logos, colors, socials, descriptions, industries, and domain/company/ticker matches.
description: Context.dev Brand: retrieve brand/company intelligence such as logos, colors, socials, descriptions, industries, and domain/company/ticker matches.

name: context_styleguide
title: Context.dev Design: extract styleguide signals and optional fonts for a domain or direct URL.
description: Context.dev Design: extract styleguide signals and optional fonts for a domain or direct URL.

name: context_classify
title: Context.dev Business: classify companies by NAICS, SIC, or EIC using domain or company name.
description: Context.dev Business: classify companies by NAICS, SIC, or EIC using domain or company name.
